products.title: Table - Solid Acacia Hardwood for Large EGG
products.body_html:
Nature takes its course. Just look at the Acacia Table. This handmade table consists of solid acacia planks and has naturally shaped grain and unique color variations. Therefore, each table is unique. The Acacia Table transforms your Big Green Egg into a complete outdoor kitchen with enough space for utensils and dishes. Place the EGG in the table on a Table Nest for necessary air circulation.

Everyone enjoys gathering around the Acacia Table thanks to its warm ambiance. As the acacia tree is incomparably the most durable and hardest wood species, it is the perfect place for a Big Green Egg Large or XLarge. And do you want to move your kitchen island? Add on four sturdy wheels so you can roll your setup to the perfect spot—whether that’s in the shade or right where the action is.

products.title: Expansion Cabinet for Modular Nest System
products.body_html:
The Big Green Egg Modular Nest System offers a customizable outdoor cooking solution. This versatile system adapts to your cooking needs, starting with the foundational EGG Frame and expanding with additional frames or the new watertight Expansion Cabinet. Customize your setup with a range of inserts, each designed to enhance your cooking workflow and storage options. The system's powder-coated aluminum construction ensures durability in outdoor environments.

The Expansion Cabinet offers:

  • Watertight storage for charcoal and accessories
  • Dimensions: 30 in L x 30 in W x 30.5 in H
  • Weight: 63 lbs.
  • Includes one Connector Pack for seamless integration
  • 4 adjustable levelers (compatible with optional 2" (5 cm) and 4" (10 cm) casters)

Pair with your favorite cabinet top (not included) to customize your ideal setup.

This modular approach allows you to build your ideal outdoor kitchen incrementally, adapting to your space and cooking style. Each component of the Nest System is engineered to work in harmony, creating a cohesive and efficient cooking environment that grows with your culinary ambitions.
